notes:
{串揚|くしあ}げ is a popular Japanese fried food.

ETYMOLOGY:
Originated in Osaka and is a specialty of the Shinsekai district.

ALSO CALLED:
⟦{串|くし}カツ→串カツ：11354_kushikatsu⟧ (kushikatsu) - more common in Osaka

SERVING STYLE:
Typically served with a communal pot of sauce. The rule {二度漬|にどづ}け⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (no double-dipping) is strictly followed for hygiene.

COMMON INGREDIENTS:
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: meat (pork, beef)
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧: vegetables (onion, lotus root)
- ⟦{海鮮|かいせん}→海鮮：05881_kaisen⟧: seafood (shrimp, squid)
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧: quail eggs
